svg.title: Figure 6｜Boundaries and data locations in the local reference
svg.desc: The boundary contains the browser frontend and Python/Streamlit process, with rules.py and Session State nested in that process. Streamlit manages frontend ↔ process communication. Frontend → operator device downloads JSON outside the boundary; the downloaded file is not a system database.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 6｜Boundaries and data locations in the local reference
Intake worker
Enters data, runs checks and downloads reports
Local intake-completeness checker
Streamlit browser frontend
Displays the interface and receives actions
Communication managed by
Streamlit
Python / Streamlit process
Processes data, checks completeness and generates reports
rules.py
Validation and export logic inside the same process
Session State
Temporary session data; not a persistent business database
Browser frontend → operator device: JSON download
Operator download folder (outside the system)
The browser downloads JSON; the operator manages the resulting files
The boundary contains the browser frontend and Python/Streamlit process
, with rules.py and Session State nested in that process. Streamlit
manages frontend ↔ process communication. Frontend → operator device
downloads JSON outside the boundary; the downloaded file is not a
